The most amazing thing was on the afternoon of the operation, which included titanium implants, with Dr Dhanish's and physio guidance I was able to stand up and begin to walk without the debilitating pain that I had previously been suffering from. I have also been waking up without the horrendous neck and shoulder pain that I had been suffering with for well over a year.

I have received amazing care from Dr Dhanish and the hospital and complete range of staff that he has arranged for me. He is still assisting me with follow ups and dressing changes over the next week to make sure that I am safe and confident for my return to the UK.

I wish I had contacted Dr Dhanish sooner to have avoided all the pain and suffering I have been through over the last year. The difference he has made for me is already absolutely life changing and it has made a massive difference to my future and the happiness of my family seeing me on the road to recovery and free of debilitating and worsening pain!

Meeting Dr Dhanish has been one of the best experiences of my life and I can't thank him enough for his skills, expertise, persona and the new lease of life I have been given.
